tools.name: company_suggest
tools.description: Company name or prefix to a list of {name, domain, logo, description}, best-known first (Clearbit Autocomplete replacement).

tools.name: company_logo
tools.description: The best logo/icon URL for a domain from the company's own site, with alternatives (Clearbit Logo replacement).

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Name, description, logo, social links, email provider (MX/SPF) and Wikidata facts (founded, HQ, industry, employees, ticker) for a domain.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Address or place to lat/lng with city, state, postal, country; US results include county, tract and block FIPS.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Coordinates to the nearest address and, in the US, county/tract/block FIPS.

tools.name: book_search
tools.description: Books by title/author or ISBN: authors, year, ISBNs, pages, rating, cover (Goodreads API replacement, Open Library data).

tools.name: encyclopedia_search
tools.description: Wikipedia full-text search: titles, URLs and snippets (for grounding after the Bing Search API retirement).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: encyclopedia_search · Public sink: company_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: encyclopedia_search · Public sink: company_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
